descriptions.d24l_textbox_caption_802c459c: Rebuilds a text box caption: when the panel +36 exists and the name +252 is not empty, detaches and releases the old caption +244, clears the text +256, loads the caption with type base+30, attaches it, scales it to (30,30,1), and, when the property name +248 resolves, formats its text into +256, stores the integer value at +264 and switches to keyboard mode 2 when non-zero. Always finishes with 0x802c4744.
